'''''Silene apetala''''' is a [[flowering plant|plant]] in the carnation family [[Caryophyllaceae]], first described in by [[Carl Ludwig Willdenow]].<ref name=APNI>{{APNI2|id=75807 
|name=''Silene apetala''}}</ref><ref>Willdenow, C.L. (1799), [https://bibdigital.rjb.csic.es/viewer/12392/?offset=#page=710&viewer=picture&o=bookmark&n=0&q= ''Species Plantarum'' Edn. 4, 2(1): 703]</ref>

This species is native in countries from the [[Mediterranean Sea|Mediterranean]] to [[Somalia|Northern Somalia]] and to [[Pakistan]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=''Silene apetala'' Willd. |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:303044-2 |access-date=2024-09-15 |website=Plants of the World Online |language=en|publisher=Kew Science}}</ref> It is listed as an invasive species in [[Australia]],<ref name=":0" /> where it is commonly found in the drier parts of [[South Australia]], [[New South Wales]] and [[Victoria (state)|Victoria]],<ref>{{cite journal|author=Laurie G. Adams|title= Silene apetala|journal=Flora of Australia|publisher= Australian Biological Resources Study, Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water: Canberra. |url=https://profiles.ala.org.au/opus/foa/profile/Silene%20apetala|access-date=15 September 2024}}</ref> and also in [[France]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Silene apetala Willd. |url=https://www.gbif.org/species/6363958 |access-date=2024-09-15 |website=www.gbif.org |language=en}}</ref>
